Key Features: • Deep Lyrics Engine: Generates real, structured songs (Verses, Chorus, Beat Drops) with multisyllabic rhyme schemes—zero AI clichés. • Beat-Synced Pacing: Auto-map visual cuts and flash effects directly to audio BPM and vocal rhythm. • Kinetic Lyric Captions:

records.name: pdf4edit
records.tagline: Pdf edit create. Detailed tools in browser + phone scan&sign
records.description: Pdf4Edit is a PDF toolkit for phone and computer. On mobile: scan, take notes, mark up, and edit quickly. On the web: the full editor — annotations, forms, stamps, drawings, and editable PDF4 projects. Pair once, then send files phone ↔ PC over the same Wi‑Fi — fast, in-app, AirDrop-style. Your files stay on your devices. Many customised tools such us rulers, shapes for students, teachers, engineers, marketing and finance

records.name: SafetyBase
records.tagline: Modern, mobile-first safety management
records.description: SafetyBase is the straightforward safety platform for workers and doers that gives you what you need to ensure compliant and safe work with straightforward, easy-to-use tools. Built with modern web technologies on ISO/SOC2 certified database infrastructure, SafetyBase includes a robust LMS and course builder, a unique position-based compliance engine, smart interactive charts, custom inspection forms, and more.

records.name: InboxSafe
records.tagline: AI phishing detection for Gmail, Outlook & LinkedIn
records.description: Phishing emails are getting harder to spot — AI makes them look real. InboxSafe analyzes Gmail, Outlook, and LinkedIn messages in real time, flagging phishing, malicious links, spoofed senders, credential theft, and social engineering before you click. Every message gets a live threat badge: Safe / Suspicious / Dangerous — with a plain-English explanation. No inbox reading. No training. Installs in seconds. Free: 30 scans/month. Pro: $12/mo. → inboxsafe.app

records.name: ScreenMark
records.tagline: Menu bar app for live annotations, whiteboard overlay + more
records.description: ScreenMark is a macOS menu bar app for live screen annotation, zoom, whiteboard overlay, freeze frame, and recording. Perfect for teachers, presenters, and developers. A free companion iPhone app turns your phone into a remote: trigger cursor highlight, flashlight, drawing and zoom. The free tier covers the core annotation tools. ScreenMark Pro unlocks recording, live zoom, cursor highlight and flashlight, advanced annotation, custom break-mode, custom shortcuts available in pro.

records.name: PackPrice
records.tagline: AI that prices packaging in seconds, not hours
records.description: PackPrice is an AI pricing tool for the packaging and printing industry. Describe the job in plain language box type, size, material, quantity and it calculates the packaging cost in seconds, then generates a PDF quote. It covers dozens of box models and thousands of formulas: folding cartons, rigid, magnetic, drawer, tube and cylinder boxes. Built for manufacturers, print shops and packaging suppliers who want to replace slow manual quoting with instant, accurate estimates.

records.name: Nipsole - Ai teacher
records.tagline: Learn anything on an AI whiteboard
records.description: Nipsole turns any topic into an interactive visual lesson. Explore expandable mind maps, watch AI teach on a hand-drawn whiteboard, or solve math problems step by step with the reasoning explained alongside the work.

records.name: Orblo
records.tagline: generate, images, ai, generate image
records.description: Orblo is a private AI photo setup for product brands. Furniture, lighting, home decor, fashion, jewelry. We tune it to your catalog, and from there you're in control: clean, catalog-ready shots from every angle, edited on the fly. Your product itself is never repainted — the AI builds the scene around it, and every shot is checked against your brand colors before you ever see it. No shoots. No presets shared with anyone else. No guessing what the AI did to your product.

records.name: SIF Agent
records.tagline: SaaS de Field Service Management (FSM)
records.description: Automatiza órdenes de trabajo, coordina técnicos en campo y elimina el desorden de WhatsApp y Excel. Prueba SIF Agent gratis por 30 días.

records.name: Donatello.studio
records.tagline: Create AI images, videos, music & voices for free
records.description: Donatello brings AI image, video, music and voice creation into one browser studio. Create from prompts and references, animate from text or start/end keyframes, compose full vocal songs or instrumentals, and generate speech, dialogue or authorized voice clones. There is no subscription, checkout or card: generators use credits earned through optional free activities, with availability and limits. Current outputs include commercial use under Donatello's terms.

records.name: Dither Studios
records.tagline: Transform Images into High-Quality Dither Art
records.description: Transform any image into high-quality dither art using a fast, precision-driven engine. Upload, tweak, and export beautifully crafted pixel-based visuals in seconds.

records.name: AI Tool Boxer
records.tagline: Discover AI Tools That Matter
records.description: AI Tool Boxer is a platform to discover and upvote the best tech products. Find top products launching daily.

records.name: PhraseLoop
records.tagline: The media looper built for musicians
records.description: With Phraseloop you can select a song, pick a section you wanna learn, loop it, slow it down and practice along with it. This is applicable for any instrumentalist or vocalist who wants to learn something hard and the speed is out of reach (right now). Phraseloop works with Youtube as well as Audio & Video files. Free, no account.

records.name: Gitar
records.tagline: AI code review that fixes what it finds
records.description: Gitar reviews pull requests, diagnoses CI failures, applies fixes, and validates the changes against your pipeline. It can also retry flaky tests, automate review workflows, and act directly inside GitHub or GitLab. Now part of Sonar.

records.name: Build Finds
records.tagline: Find Tools. Build Better.
records.description: Build Finds is a platform to discover and upvote the best tech products. Find top products launching daily.

records.name: Clinitraq.ai
records.tagline: The AI operating system for medical & dental practices
records.description: Clinitraq.ai is the first fully AI-driven operating system for medical and dental practices. AI voice agents answer every call 24/7, book appointments, verify insurance, and handle billing — while call-intelligence coaching improves your front desk automatically. A unified CRM and two-way EMR/payer sync tie it all together. Practices cut front-desk and billing costs 30–40% while patients get answered in under 2 seconds, in English or Spanish, any time of day.

records.name: SudokuFR
records.tagline: Free Sudoku for French players, from 4×4 to Samurai
records.description: SudokuFR is a free Sudoku platform built for French-speaking players. Play classic 9×9 puzzles, daily challenges, Sudoku X, Killer, Irregular, 4×4, 6×6, 16×16 and Samurai. Use notes, hints, candidates, stats and achievements, or solve and print grids. No account required — just open and play.

records.name: Neck To Choke
records.tagline: Free security scanner for AI-built apps
records.description: AI taught everyone to build. Nobody taught them what could go wrong. NeckToChoke scans any URL and returns plain-English security findings in seconds. No jargon. No certifications required to understand the results. Built for vibe coders who shipped something and have no idea if it's safe. Free. No signup. Paste a URL, get the truth.

records.name: FinanceAI Pro
records.tagline: AI finance app in Spanish — YNAB alternative with OCR + AI
records.description: FinanceAI Pro helps Spanish-speaking families take control of their money using AI. - Scan receipts with OCR - AI budget coach in Spanish - Track expenses, debts & savings - Gift subscriptions for loved ones - Works on any device, no app install needed YNAB & Copilot are English-only. We built this for the 600M Spanish speakers who deserve the same tools. Free plan available. Founder pricing ends soon.

records.name: WorkSphere
records.tagline: Build your profile. Prove your skills. Get hired. Get paid.
records.description: WorkSphere combines professional networking and freelance work in one platform. Build a professional profile, showcase your portfolio and skills, discover full-time jobs and freelance projects, connect with professionals, and turn verified skills into real opportunities. Unlike traditional job boards, WorkSphere is designed around the complete journey from professional identity to paid work.

records.name: VectorDarts
records.tagline: Play. Practice. Compete
records.description: VectorOS is the all-in-one platform for darts players to score matches, track stats, practice with purpose, compete, and manage leagues. Built by a passionate darts player, VectorOS brings everything together in one modern experience to help players improve and grow the game. Join our early access community and help shape the future of darts.

records.name: PenPace
records.tagline: Read text in paced chunks for distraction-free handwriting
records.description: PenPace helps you copy text by hand without constantly looking back at your screen. Paste any text, and it reads it aloud in short, paced chunks so you can stay focused on writing. Unlike traditional text-to-speech, it's designed around handwriting rather than continuous listening. Everything runs locally in your browser - no uploads, no tracking, no account required, and completely free.

records.name: How Machines Think
records.tagline: Learn AI from first principles.
records.description: Before AI, there was logic. Before neural networks, there was mathematics. Discover the ideas and breakthroughs behind modern artificial intelligence. Click to read How Machines Think, a Substack publication. Launched 10 days ago.

records.name: Trace by Aura
records.tagline: Remember why everything you save mattered
records.description: Most apps remember the item. Trace remembers the meaning. Save links, reels, screenshots, notes, and voice together with the thought that made each one worth keeping. Trace organizes your collection privately on device, so what matters stays close and easy to recall. There is no Trace account, no Trace server, no advertising, no analytics, and no tracking. Optional iCloud keeps your collection available across Apple devices. Built by Karthik Barma for a quieter, more intentional way to save.

records.name: WDM
records.tagline: Fast downloads and browser media capture for macOS
records.description: WDM combines a fast multi-connection download manager with browser media capture in one clean macOS workflow. Save regular files, videos, MP3s, and complete image batches from supported webpages directly to your Mac. It includes pause and resume, accurate progress, notifications, YouTube quality selection, and native Apple Silicon and Intel builds. There is a 7-day free trial and one-time lifetime pricing—no subscription.

records.name: Photogenix for Shopify
records.tagline: Refresh your catalog visuals and sync them to Shopify
records.description: Photogenix helps Shopify fashion brands refresh entire catalogs without costly, repetitive photoshoots. Generate consistent product photos and videos in bulk. Apply your brand style across every SKU. Review the assets you want and then sync approved visuals directly to Shopify. Cut weeks of production and manual work down to a single day.

records.name: Retail Tool Suite
records.tagline: Essential tools to simplify retail management
records.description: Retail Tool Suite brings multiple helpful retail calculators and utilities into one simple platform. It helps businesses and retailers manage everyday tasks faster with easy-to-use tools for pricing, planning, and decision-making. Unlike scattered solutions, it provides a centralized toolkit designed to save time and improve retail workflow efficiency.
